name: GYCAF Microgrants
summary: Microgrants of up to $1,000 for youth-led groups (at least 80% of the core team aged 18–30) running local climate and environment projects; only 3 to 5 projects are picked per round. Of its six focus areas, only nature-based solutions and oceans fit restoration and conservation work.

eligibility.rule: At least 80% of the leadership or core project team is aged 18–30
The project tackles a climate or environmental challenge in a specific community
Young people have a meaningful leadership role in designing and carrying out the project
The grant launches a new initiative or strengthens an existing youth-led project

status.quote: Applications for the 2026 Microgrants are open and close December 31st, 2026

deadline.quote: Applications for the 2026 Microgrants are open and close December 31st, 2026

applicant_types.quote: Be a youth-led organization, network, initiative, or grassroots group, with at least 80% of its leadership or core project team aged 18–30.

access.quote: Eligible applications are reviewed by select criteria and scorecards.

amount.quote: Each selected project will receive a grant ranging up to USD 1,000.

effort.quote: Eligible applications are reviewed by select criteria and scorecards.

eligibility.quote: Be a youth-led organization, network, initiative, or grassroots group, with at least 80% of its leadership or core project team aged 18–30.
Demonstrate that the proposed project addresses an identified climate or environmental challenge within a community.
Demonstrate meaningful youth leadership in the design and implementation of the project.
Be seeking funding either to launch a new initiative or strengthen an existing youth-led project.
